gen-gf-pangolin-fs-public-sans: Friendly and relaxed, Pangolin writes in a single-nib line with tall, generous lowercase letters. But Public Sans is the sturdier one, its hefty lowercase and broad counters making steady, trustworthy text.
gen-gf-pangolin-fs-supreme: Pangolin draws tall, generous letters in an unbroken monoline stroke, friendly and relaxed. Supreme then adds a crisp, heavy-looking band of text with letters held open, and that warm-meets-crisp tension is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-pangolin-general-sans: Relaxed and friendly, Pangolin leads with a hand-drawn nib line and tall, generous lowercase. General Sans enters as a sans-serif with steady pressure, smooth curves and a tall x-height, giving the handwriting room to carry the personality.
gen-gf-pangolin-manrope: A drawn-with-one-nib line gives Pangolin tall, generous lowercase and wide c apertures, friendly and relaxed in every word. Manrope keeps paragraphs light, its curves wide open at the mouth.
gen-gf-pangolin-satoshi: Satoshi comes in tall, its x-height soaring and its e wide open. Pangolin brings friendly, relaxed, hand-drawn warmth, and paragraphs in this plain sans glide along on uniform strokes.
gen-gf-pangolin-switzer: Friendly and relaxed, Pangolin writes tall, generous lowercase. Switzer, tubular and wire-like with a tall waist line, brings a Swiss, approachable structure, and that loose-meets-tidy mix is what makes this pairing stick.
gen-gf-pangolin-work-sans: Relaxed and friendly, Pangolin carries a one-nib hand-drawn look with tall, generous lowercase and wide c apertures. Work Sans reads modern and smooth, its high mean line keeping text open.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-bespoke-sans: Relaxed and personal, Playpen Sans draws welcoming curves with no stress or shading, a hand-drawn look that feels warm. Bespoke Sans handles the sharp, refined part, leaving generous room at curve ends.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-literata: Literata is a sophisticated, bookish serif with sturdy thin lines. Under Playpen Sans's relaxed, hand-drawn heading, those slightly heavier thick strokes and open curves make paragraphs feel gently unhurried.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-bespoke-sa: Playpen Sans Arabic draws friendly, inviting round bowls in a steady drafting-pen line, with curve tips that never touch. Bespoke Sans takes the refined side, leaving generous space between curve ends and stem.
